component.name: LinDriveSpace
component.summary: See where your disk space goes

description.p: LinDriveSpace is a native GTK 3 disk-space explorer for Linux Mint and other Debian-family desktops. It lists every mount and partition, scans them in the background, and lets you drill from folders down to files with apparent and allocated sizes, counts, share bars and last-modified dates.

An Analysis panel adds a treemap, largest files, file types and an age histogram. History records usage automatically, charts it by day, week, month or year, and shows exactly which folders and files grew or shrank between scans. A background collector can run on a schedule, and a Hardware page describes the disks and controllers without root.
